sample.Visitor's Name & Details: Prof Dr. Alex Wilson, Prof Dr. Julie McCandless
sample.Summary:
On 21st November 2025, we had the pleasure of hosting Prof. Dr. Alex Wilson and Prof. Dr. Julie McCandless from Queen’s University Belfast, UK (#199 Qs Ranking) for a guest lecture at the School of Management Studies. The session focused on Global Careers for Business Graduates and offered valuable guidance on developing international career pathways. The professors also introduced their MBA program, sharing details on admission requirements, curriculum structure, career prospects, and student life at Queen’s University Belfast, which was highly informative for our students.

Following the lecture, the professors met with the Dean of the School of Management Studies for a focused discussion on strengthening academic ties between our institutions. The conversation covered several potential areas of collaboration, including student exchange programs, scholar-in-residence opportunities, and short-term immersion programs.

sample.Event Summary:
Dayananda Sagar University, International Affairs Department organized an event “Welcome - Meet and Greet and Partnership Program” on March 23, 2023. The program started with a welcome dance organised by Ms. Shyamantha Surya Prakash and Team, followed by Meet and Greet.
 
 
Welcome with Dr. Dan Heimmermann and Mr. Ani Agnihotri

The program then followed with a welcome address by Dr. Amit Bhatt, Pro Vice Chancellor, DSU. The dignitaries on the Dias were Dr. Dan Heimmermann, Chancellor, University of South Carolina Aiken, USA, Mr. Ani Agnihotri, Co-Founder and CEO at Marshall Automation America, Inc, Dr. K N Balasubrmanya Murthy, Vice Chancellor, DSU, Dr. Puttamadappa C, Registrar, DSU, Ms. Supriya Mathew, Vice president of International affairs & Admissions DSU, Dr. Uday Kumar Reddy, Dean SoE, CSE, Dr.Girisha G S, Chairperson, CSE, Dr. Pramod Naik, Associate Prof, CSE, Dr. M K Banga, Dean, CSE, Dr. Basavaraj N Hiremath, Prof, DSU, Dr. Niranjan Appaswamy, Associate Prof, DSU, Dr. Shaila S.G, Chairperson, DS, DSU , Dr. M Shahina Parveen, Chairperson, CST, DSU.
